label: Crime Act and COPS grants
note: Violent Crime Control and Law Enforcement Act signed 13 September 1994; its COPS program funded local officer hiring from FY1995.

label: Great Recession
note: Recession December 2007 to June 2009; local property and sales tax revenue fell with a lag, and city budgets contracted into 2012.

label: CARES Act
note: Coronavirus Aid, Relief, and Economic Security Act signed 27 March 2020, including the Coronavirus Relief Fund for state and local governments.

label: ARPA recovery funds
note: American Rescue Plan Act signed 11 March 2021 created the $350bn State and Local Fiscal Recovery Funds, spent through 2026.

label: Proposition 13
note: Capped property tax rates at 1% of assessed value and limited assessment growth, shifting California cities toward sales and other revenue.

label: Proposition 2 and a half
note: Capped the property tax levy at 2.5% of assessed value and annual levy growth at 2.5%.

label: TABOR
note: Taxpayer's Bill of Rights limited revenue growth and required votes for tax increases.

label: Senate Bill 2
note: Property Tax Reform and Transparency Act lowered the voter-approval rate for cities to 3.5% growth in maintenance and operations revenue.
